title_block.title: Test Model 2
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Complex Test Case 2 - View 1 (of 3). Includes Atomic Test Cases - 28, 29, 43, 47, 50; PMI Complex Test Case 2 - View 2 (of 3). Includes Atomic Test Cases - 26, 31, 41; PMI Complex Test Case 2 - View 3 (of 3). Includes Atomic Test Cases - 34, 35
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset)

features.label: whole housing
features.description: The part as a whole. General notes apply to all of it.

features.label: top face of the housing
features.description: The large flat top face of the housing in view 1. Datum target point A1 sits on it, near the back corner.

features.label: counterbore in the two side bosses (2X)
features.description: Large round counterbore in the face of each of the two cylindrical bosses on the side walls of the housing. The 2X covers both bosses.

features.label: front side wall below the right boss
features.description: Flat front wall of the housing below the right-hand boss in view 1. A short supplemental line drawn on it marks the line element that the profile-of-a-line control applies to.

features.label: raised rim face around the top pocket
features.description: Flat raised rim around the stepped pocket in the top of the housing, carrying the ring of small bolt holes (view 2).

features.label: end face inside the right side boss
features.description: Flat face at the centre of the right-hand side boss in view 2. The hatched circle on it is datum target area K1.

features.label: face of the right mounting lug
features.description: Flat face of the tall mounting lug with two holes on the right of view 3, next to the open bolting flange.

features.label: bolting flange face
features.description: Flat face of the rectangular bolting flange around the open side of the housing in view 3, with its ring of small holes. It is datum feature D.

values.meaning: Datum target point A1: one of the three points on the top face (A1, A2, A3) that together set up datum A.
Each of the two side-boss counterbores must be 100 mm in diameter plus or minus 0.15 mm, so between 99.85 and 100.15 mm.

Position at maximum material condition: the axis of each counterbore must lie in a 1.5 mm diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C; the zone grows as the bore departs from its smallest size.

values.applies_to: the line element drawn on the wall as supplemental geometry
values.meaning: Profile of a line: along the marked line element, the wall's cross-section must lie between two lines 0.25 mm apart around its true shape, located from datums A, B and C.

values.raw: 3. ASME Y14.5M-1994 APPLIES TO DIMENSIONING AND TOLERANCING.
values.meaning: General note 3: dimensions and tolerances are read under ASME Y14.5M-1994.
Title of the sheet: NIST test model 2.

Profile of a surface, unequally disposed: the rim face must lie in a 2.5 mm wide band around its true shape, located from datums A, B and C, with 0.5 mm of the band on the outside of the material and 2.0 mm inside.
Datum target area K1: a circular area 85 mm in diameter (basic) on the boss end face, used to set up datum K.
Profile of a surface: the lug face must lie in a 0.5 mm band around its true shape, located from datum D and from datum features E and F at their maximum material boundary.
Datum feature D: the bolting flange face is the primary datum for the D, E, F frames. The symbol hangs from the flatness frame that controls this face.
